title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
excerpt: Cloudflare OS is an open-source platform that lets everyone in your company build apps, automate work, and safely access internal systems, shaped around what your organization knows and how it operates.
content_html:
Every organization has a mission, a reason for being. Organizations pass that mission — along with their terminology, procedures, systems, standards, and ways of working — to their people. People, in turn, take this context together with their own experience and work towards the mission.

Work can take many forms, from code, to documents and slides, to relationships, to outcomes in the physical world.

Some of these are straightforward: code either runs or it doesn’t. Agents have been using this feedback loop to produce code that “works” for developers over the last couple of years. But what about the rest of us?

Bringing the same leverage to the rest of the organization is a harder problem. Agents need to understand the context of the company and be able to reach the systems people use to do their jobs. They need to turn that context and access into work that moves the organization towards its mission.

That’s why we created Cloudflare OS. It gives every person an agent and workspace built around their company: how it works, what it knows, and the systems it relies on.

In May of this year, we gave every person at Cloudflare access to the first version of Cloudflare OS. Thousands of people across every function, many of them outside of engineering, use it every day to create documents and slides, automate repeatable tasks, and build small apps to visualize data and help them do their work.

Cloudflare OS also gave everyone a shared library of context and skills built by teams at Cloudflare. It captures our terminology, procedures, and best-known ways of doing recurring work as instructions an agent can follow. When one person figures out a better way to do something, everyone else can use it.

Today, we are open sourcing a new version of Cloudflare OS. Any organization can deploy it, connect it to internal systems, and make it their own.

What we learned from the first version

The Cloudflare OS we are open sourcing today is based on what we learned from running the first version internally, a journey our CIO, Sam Rhea, covers in his blog post.

The first version centered on individuals working with agents through private workspaces. Apps were static rather than live software connected to internal systems, and mostly deterministic jobs still required running an agent skill again and consuming more model tokens.

Collaboration exposed a more fundamental challenge. Access to an MCP server told us which tools an agent could call, but not which underlying resources the agent had observed. Once people began sharing workspaces, apps, and outputs, we needed to ensure that collaboration could not expose information someone was not permitted to see.

We rebuilt Cloudflare OS on a new foundation to solve these problems. Security had to be part of the platform, not something every person building an app or using an agent has to implement correctly.

The result is a platform designed to belong to the company running it. You can customize the interfaces, connect your tools, and add the skills and context that capture how your organization works.

Introducing Cloudflare OS

Cloudflare OS starts with a conversation in your browser, like many other AI tools. What makes it different is that each conversation is grounded in the context and skills your organization has curated. Give your workspace a goal, and it can draw on that knowledge and work with the tools and data your organization already uses to achieve it.

Cloudflare OS combines three parts:

  • An agent workspace grounded in context and skills your company curates, with an isolated runtime where agents can write and run code.
  • A new security and governance framework for safe access to internal data and services.
  • A platform for personal, modifiable apps that people can build, share, and continue changing.

What begins as a conversation can become a doc, an app, or a workflow that continues doing the work.

An agent workspace for everyone in your company

Agent workspaces were designed for everyone in your organization to use. You interact with them in your browser, so you don’t have to be a developer or know how to use a terminal. 

A workspace combines agent sessions, persistent state, outputs and files, resource access, and an isolated runtime where the agent can write and run code.

They come loaded with the curated context and skills your team or company has collected. No more reinventing the wheel for every task — if someone on your team has figured out the best way to do something, everyone benefits. People no longer have to explain the same process, terminology, and best practices to a model every time they start a task.

A few things you can do:

Research and ask questions

Ask a workspace to research a topic using company context and the resources you make available to it. The agent can write code to search, filter, join, and analyze information instead of pulling an entire dataset into the model’s context window.

Create docs, slides, and spreadsheets

A workspace can turn its research into a document, presentation, or spreadsheet that you can continue editing. These outputs do not have to be static files. They can remain connected to live data, be updated as their sources change, and still be exported to familiar formats or services such as Google Drive.

Create collaborative, connected apps for your team

When a document or spreadsheet is not enough, the agent can build an app with its own interface, logic, and state. The app can use connected company resources and support multiple people working together.

Run deterministic workflows 

Not every job needs a full agent session. Many are a known sequence of steps with one or two places where judgment is useful. A workspace can turn those jobs into mostly deterministic workflows, using code for the predictable steps and a model only where it adds value. Workflows can run on demand, on a schedule, or when an event occurs in a connected system.

Cloudflare OS gives agents and apps governed access to systems of record through Gatekeepers (more on this in the security section below). It also supports existing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers your organization already uses via MCP Server Portals.

A new security and governance framework for safe access to internal data and services

As people begin experimenting with AI at work, one of their first requests is often for API keys to company systems. This makes sense: AI isn’t much use at work if it doesn’t have access to the systems people use to do their jobs.

But handing over API keys to people and agents is dangerous and does not scale. Keys often provide broad, long-lived access that is difficult to constrain, share safely, and audit.

MCP gives agents a better way to use these systems. An MCP server can hold the credential and expose a defined set of tools instead of handing the key directly to the agent. But controlling which tools an agent can call is only the first step. MCP alone does not tell us which underlying resources an agent has observed. The agent can combine information across systems, send it somewhere less restricted, or expose it through apps and outputs to people who may not be allowed to see the original resources. Authorization has to account for where the data can go next.

Agents start with no access

Cloudflare Access controls who can enter Cloudflare OS. Inside, every agent and app starts with access to nothing. An agent can ask for access to a specific resource, which you can grant or deny. Generated code receives that resource as a typed binding:

const issues = await env.PROJECT.listIssues({
  teamId: "ENG",
  state: "open",
});

env.PROJECT is a capability representing permission to use a specific resource under a specific policy. The credential remains completely isolated from the agent and any generated code.

Server code runs in a Dynamic Worker with global outbound networking disabled. Client code runs in a sandboxed frame in the browser. Neither can reach the Internet except through capabilities you explicitly provide.

Gatekeepers govern resources and actions

A Gatekeeper is a service-specific Worker that sits between Cloudflare OS and an external service. It understands the service’s API, its resources, and the operations that can be performed on them.

Giving an agent access to your entire GitHub account is likely too broad. A Gatekeeper can give it access to a single repository, allow it to read issues but not source code, mask particular fields, apply rate limits, and require approval before merging a pull request.

The agent and its apps see a small TypeScript API. The Gatekeeper handles OAuth, holds the credential, enforces policy, records what was read, and mediates anything with an externally visible side effect.

Policy follows what the agent has seen

Controlling the initial read is not enough. Take, for example, the case where an agent reads a sensitive table in a data warehouse and uses it to produce a live dashboard. Sharing the dashboard must not become a way to share the table with people who could not access it directly.

Cloudflare OS records every resource agents observe. These observations remain attached to the agent and its work. When another person tries to open the workspace, interact with the agent, or view what it produced, Gatekeepers verify that person's access to the observed resources.

The same observation log is used to inform policies that determine when agents can make external requests. A read of sensitive data can prevent the agent from writing data to certain sources, inviting new collaborators, handing work to another agent, or making an outbound request.

People using agents or building apps do not have to worry about making these mistakes. The platform can now be used to handle this.

A platform for building and sharing personal, modifiable apps

Most productivity suites give you a fixed set of applications: documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. In Cloudflare OS, each “file” can be its own application, written by an agent for one person, one project, or one team.

These are not prototypes that you have to export and deploy somewhere else. Each one is a full-stack application with client code, server code, an API, and durable state. Apps are private by default, but can be shared like documents.

Every app is a Worker

When you ask your workspace to build an app, the agent writes two parts:

  • Client code that renders the app’s UI in the browser
  • Server code that stores state and implements the app’s behavior

The server is loaded on demand as a Dynamic Worker and instantiated as a Durable Object Facet (both are features we built for this project). The facet gives the app its own SQLite database, separate from the Cloudflare OS runtime managing it. Dynamic Workers use lightweight V8 isolates, so every app can have its own isolated runtime without needing a dedicated server or container sitting around.

The browser client talks to the server using Cap’n Web, Cloudflare’s open source object-capability Remote Procedure Call (RPC) system. A server method can be called from the client like a normal JavaScript function:

const issues = await app.listIssues({
 status: "done",
});

The special part is that the agent can also call the same method.

So if you can build a tool to do a job yourself, agents can use your tool to do the job when you’re not there.

Share the app, or share how it was built

When you build an app in Cloudflare OS, you have two ways to share them:

  • Sharing your app itself lets other people collaborate in real time using the same state.
  • Sharing a blueprint of your app lets other people create their own copy of your app.

An app instantiated from a blueprint contains the original app’s code. But it does not contain its SQLite data, conversation history, credentials, or connected resources. Each new app starts with independent state and resources.

This means when you share apps with your team, they can modify them themselves with AI instead of filing a feature request and assigning you.

Use any model, and control what it costs

Cloudflare OS can be used with any model. Every inference call runs through Cloudflare AI Gateway, giving your organization one place to decide which models are available and which model should handle each job.

Not every task needs the most expensive model. You may not want to run the most expensive frontier model to summarize your unread emails every morning. AI Gateway gives you the control needed to make sure expensive models are only being used for the hardest work.

Every request is attributed to the person, team, or workspace that made it. Administrators can see where inference spend is going, set budgets and rate limits, and decide what happens when a limit is reached. 

Open source, so you can make it yours

Cloudflare OS is available today and is open source. Check out the cloudflare-os GitHub repository. You can deploy it into your own Cloudflare account and use your own Access policies, AI Gateway configuration, data, and integrations.

Our internal deployment reflects Cloudflare’s systems, terminology, policies, and ways of working. Yours should reflect your organization.

Cloudflare OS is designed so you can customize the interface, add internal Gatekeepers, and build organization-specific features without changing the core product.

We are releasing two repositories: the Cloudflare OS core and an example deployment based on how we run it internally at Cloudflare. The deployment repository consumes the core without patching it, providing a place for configuration, custom UI, internal integrations, analytics, and deployment pipelines.

Delivered together with our partners

The source code is only the starting point. The context, skills, workflows, internal systems, and policies are what make Cloudflare OS even more useful for your organization.

Cloudflare’s strategic partners, Presidio and Happy Cog, will work with you to customize Cloudflare OS around how your organization operates and roll it out across your workforce.

Partners can help you curate shared skills and institutional context, build custom interfaces, connect internal systems through Gatekeepers and MCP Server Portals, and configure security, model, and cost controls.

You get your own branded Cloudflare OS, connected to your systems, running on Cloudflare, and shaped around how your people actually work.

Get started

Cloudflare OS is available today on GitHub. You can explore the source code, try the demo, or deploy it into your own Cloudflare account in a few minutes using our starter repository.

We’re just getting started. We’re working on bringing Cloudflare OS to the Cloudflare dashboard as a fully managed product, adding containers for development workflows, and bringing workspaces into Slack and other chat tools.

If you’re interested in talking with our team, we would love to chat. Use this form to reach out!

sentences.zh: 任何组织都可以部署它，将其连接到内部系统，并使其成为自己的系统。

blocks.html_en: What we learned from the first version

sentences.en: What we learned from the first version
sentences.zh: 我们从第一个版本中学到了什么

blocks.html_en: The Cloudflare OS we are open sourcing today is based on what we learned from running the first version internally, a journey our CIO, Sam Rhea, covers in his blog post.

sentences.en: The Cloudflare OS we are open sourcing today is based on what we learned from running the first version internally, a journey our CIO, Sam Rhea, covers in his blog post.
sentences.zh: 我们今天开源的 Cloudflare 操作系统基于我们从内部运行第一个版本中学到的知识，我们的首席信息官 Sam Rhea 在他的博客文章中介绍了这一历程。

blocks.html_en: The first version centered on individuals working with agents through private workspaces. Apps were static rather than live software connected to internal systems, and mostly deterministic jobs still required running an agent skill again and consuming more model tokens.

sentences.en: The first version centered on individuals working with agents through private workspaces.
sentences.zh: 第一个版本以个人通过私人工作空间与代理合作为中心。

sentences.en: Apps were static rather than live software connected to internal systems, and mostly deterministic jobs still required running an agent skill again and consuming more model tokens.
sentences.zh: 应用程序是静态的，而不是连接到内部系统的实时软件，并且大多数确定性作业仍然需要再次运行代理技能并消耗更多的模型令牌。

blocks.html_en: Collaboration exposed a more fundamental challenge. Access to an MCP server told us which tools an agent could call, but not which underlying resources the agent had observed. Once people began sharing workspaces, apps, and outputs, we needed to ensure that collaboration could not expose information someone was not permitted to see.

sentences.en: Collaboration exposed a more fundamental challenge.
sentences.zh: 合作暴露了一个更根本的挑战。

sentences.en: Access to an MCP server told us which tools an agent could call, but not which underlying resources the agent had observed.
sentences.zh: 对 MCP 服务器的访问告诉我们代理可以调用​​哪些工具，但没有告诉我们代理观察到了哪些底层资源。

sentences.en: Once people began sharing workspaces, apps, and outputs, we needed to ensure that collaboration could not expose information someone was not permitted to see.
sentences.zh: 一旦人们开始共享工作空间、应用程序和输出，我们就需要确保协作不会泄露他人不被允许看到的信息。

blocks.html_en: We rebuilt Cloudflare OS on a new foundation to solve these problems. Security had to be part of the platform, not something every person building an app or using an agent has to implement correctly.

sentences.en: We rebuilt Cloudflare OS on a new foundation to solve these problems.
sentences.zh: 我们在新的基础上重建了 Cloudflare OS 来解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Security had to be part of the platform, not something every person building an app or using an agent has to implement correctly.
sentences.zh: 安全性必须成为平台的一部分，而不是每个构建应用程序或使用代理的人都必须正确实现。

blocks.html_en: The result is a platform designed to belong to the company running it. You can customize the interfaces, connect your tools, and add the skills and context that capture how your organization works.

sentences.en: The result is a platform designed to belong to the company running it.
sentences.zh: 结果是一个设计为属于运行它的公司的平台。

sentences.en: You can customize the interfaces, connect your tools, and add the skills and context that capture how your organization works.
sentences.zh: 您可以自定义界面、连接工具并添加捕捉组织运作方式的技能和上下文。

blocks.html_en: Introducing Cloudflare OS

sentences.en: Introducing Cloudflare OS
sentences.zh: Cloudflare 操作系统简介

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare OS starts with a conversation in your browser, like many other AI tools. What makes it different is that each conversation is grounded in the context and skills your organization has curated. Give your workspace a goal, and it can draw on that knowledge and work with the tools and data your organization already uses to achieve it.

sentences.en: Cloudflare OS starts with a conversation in your browser, like many other AI tools.
sentences.zh: 与许多其他 AI 工具一样，Cloudflare OS 从浏览器中的对话开始。

sentences.en: What makes it different is that each conversation is grounded in the context and skills your organization has curated.
sentences.zh: 其与众不同之处在于，每次对话都基于您的组织策划的背景和技能。

sentences.en: Give your workspace a goal, and it can draw on that knowledge and work with the tools and data your organization already uses to achieve it.
sentences.zh: 为您的工作空间设定一个目标，它可以利用该知识并使用您的组织已使用的工具和数据来实现该目标。

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare OS combines three parts:

sentences.en: Cloudflare OS combines three parts:
sentences.zh: Cloudflare OS 结合了三个部分：

blocks.html_en: • An agent workspace grounded in context and skills your company curates, with an isolated runtime where agents can write and run code.

sentences.en: An agent workspace grounded in context and skills your company curates, with an isolated runtime where agents can write and run code.
sentences.zh: 座席工作区基于您公司策划的上下文和技能，具有隔离的运行时，座席可以在其中编写和运行代码。

blocks.html_en: • A new security and governance framework for safe access to internal data and services.

sentences.en: A new security and governance framework for safe access to internal data and services.
sentences.zh: 用于安全访问内部数据和服务的新安全和治理框架。

blocks.html_en: • A platform for personal, modifiable apps that people can build, share, and continue changing.

sentences.en: A platform for personal, modifiable apps that people can build, share, and continue changing.
sentences.zh: 一个个人、可修改应用程序的平台，人们可以构建、共享和继续更改。

blocks.html_en: What begins as a conversation can become a doc, an app, or a workflow that continues doing the work.

sentences.en: What begins as a conversation can become a doc, an app, or a workflow that continues doing the work.
sentences.zh: 最初的对话可以成为文档、应用程序或继续工作的工作流程。

blocks.html_en: An agent workspace for everyone in your company

sentences.en: An agent workspace for everyone in your company
sentences.zh: 适合公司每个人的座席工作空间

blocks.html_en: Agent workspaces were designed for everyone in your organization to use. You interact with them in your browser, so you don’t have to be a developer or know how to use a terminal.

sentences.en: Agent workspaces were designed for everyone in your organization to use.
sentences.zh: 代理工作区专为组织中的每个人而设计。

sentences.en: You interact with them in your browser, so you don’t have to be a developer or know how to use a terminal.
sentences.zh: 您可以在浏览器中与它们交互，因此您不必是开发人员或知道如何使用终端。

blocks.html_en: A workspace combines agent sessions, persistent state, outputs and files, resource access, and an isolated runtime where the agent can write and run code.

sentences.en: A workspace combines agent sessions, persistent state, outputs and files, resource access, and an isolated runtime where the agent can write and run code.
sentences.zh: 工作区结合了代理会话、持久状态、输出和文件、资源访问以及代理可以在其中编写和运行代码的隔离运行时。

blocks.html_en: They come loaded with the curated context and skills your team or company has collected. No more reinventing the wheel for every task — if someone on your team has figured out the best way to do something, everyone benefits. People no longer have to explain the same process, terminology, and best practices to a model every time they start a task.

sentences.en: They come loaded with the curated context and skills your team or company has collected.
sentences.zh: 它们充满了您的团队或公司收集的精选背景和技能。

sentences.en: No more reinventing the wheel for every task — if someone on your team has figured out the best way to do something, everyone benefits.
sentences.zh: 不再需要为每项任务重新发明轮子——如果团队中有人找到了做某事的最佳方法，那么每个人都会受益。

sentences.en: People no longer have to explain the same process, terminology, and best practices to a model every time they start a task.
sentences.zh: 人们不再需要在每次开始任务时向模型解释相同的流程、术语和最佳实践。

blocks.html_en: A few things you can do:

sentences.en: A few things you can do:
sentences.zh: 您可以做一些事情：

blocks.html_en: Research and ask questions

sentences.en: Research and ask questions
sentences.zh: 研究并提出问题

blocks.html_en: Ask a workspace to research a topic using company context and the resources you make available to it. The agent can write code to search, filter, join, and analyze information instead of pulling an entire dataset into the model’s context window.

sentences.en: Ask a workspace to research a topic using company context and the resources you make available to it.
sentences.zh: 要求工作空间使用公司背景和您提供的资源来研究某个主题。

sentences.en: The agent can write code to search, filter, join, and analyze information instead of pulling an entire dataset into the model’s context window.
sentences.zh: 代理可以编写代码来搜索、过滤、连接和分析信息，而不是将整个数据集拉入模型的上下文窗口。

blocks.html_en: Create docs, slides, and spreadsheets

sentences.en: Create docs, slides, and spreadsheets
sentences.zh: 创建文档、幻灯片和电子表格

blocks.html_en: A workspace can turn its research into a document, presentation, or spreadsheet that you can continue editing. These outputs do not have to be static files. They can remain connected to live data, be updated as their sources change, and still be exported to familiar formats or services such as Google Drive.

sentences.en: A workspace can turn its research into a document, presentation, or spreadsheet that you can continue editing.
sentences.zh: 工作区可以将其研究转化为您可以继续编辑的文档、演示文稿或电子表格。

sentences.en: These outputs do not have to be static files.
sentences.zh: 这些输出不必是静态文件。

sentences.en: They can remain connected to live data, be updated as their sources change, and still be exported to familiar formats or services such as Google Drive.
sentences.zh: 它们可以保持与实时数据的连接，随着来源的变化而更新，并且仍然可以导出为熟悉的格式或服务，例如 Google Drive。

blocks.html_en: Create collaborative, connected apps for your team

sentences.en: Create collaborative, connected apps for your team
sentences.zh: 为您的团队创建协作、互联的应用程序

blocks.html_en: When a document or spreadsheet is not enough, the agent can build an app with its own interface, logic, and state. The app can use connected company resources and support multiple people working together.

sentences.en: When a document or spreadsheet is not enough, the agent can build an app with its own interface, logic, and state.
sentences.zh: 当文档或电子表格不够时，代理可以构建具有自己的界面、逻辑和状态的应用程序。

sentences.en: The app can use connected company resources and support multiple people working together.
sentences.zh: 该应用程序可以使用连接的公司资源并支持多人协同工作。

blocks.html_en: Run deterministic workflows

sentences.en: Run deterministic workflows
sentences.zh: 运行确定性工作流程

blocks.html_en: Not every job needs a full agent session. Many are a known sequence of steps with one or two places where judgment is useful. A workspace can turn those jobs into mostly deterministic workflows, using code for the predictable steps and a model only where it adds value. Workflows can run on demand, on a schedule, or when an event occurs in a connected system.

sentences.en: Not every job needs a full agent session.
sentences.zh: 并非每项工作都需要完整的代理会话。

sentences.en: Many are a known sequence of steps with one or two places where judgment is useful.
sentences.zh: 许多都是已知的步骤序列，其中有一两个地方的判断是有用的。

sentences.en: A workspace can turn those jobs into mostly deterministic workflows, using code for the predictable steps and a model only where it adds value.
sentences.zh: 工作区可以将这些作业转变为大部分确定性的工作流程，使用可预测步骤的代码和仅在增加价值的地方使用模型。

sentences.en: Workflows can run on demand, on a schedule, or when an event occurs in a connected system.
sentences.zh: 工作流程可以按需、按计划运行，或者在连接的系统中发生事件时运行。

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare OS gives agents and apps governed access to systems of record through Gatekeepers (more on this in the security section below). It also supports existing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers your organization already uses via MCP Server Portals.

sentences.en: Cloudflare OS gives agents and apps governed access to systems of record through Gatekeepers (more on this in the security section below).
sentences.zh: Cloudflare OS 允许代理和应用程序通过 Gatekeepers 管理对记录系统的访问（更多信息请参见下面的安全部分）。

sentences.en: It also supports existing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers your organization already uses via MCP Server Portals.
sentences.zh: 它还支持您的组织已通过 MCP 服务器门户使用的现有模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器。

blocks.html_en: A new security and governance framework for safe access to internal data and services

sentences.en: A new security and governance framework for safe access to internal data and services
sentences.zh: 用于安全访问内部数据和服务的新安全和治理框架

blocks.html_en: As people begin experimenting with AI at work, one of their first requests is often for API keys to company systems. This makes sense: AI isn’t much use at work if it doesn’t have access to the systems people use to do their jobs.

sentences.en: As people begin experimenting with AI at work, one of their first requests is often for API keys to company systems.
sentences.zh: 当人们开始在工作中尝试人工智能时，他们的第一个请求通常是获取公司系统的 API 密钥。

sentences.en: This makes sense: AI isn’t much use at work if it doesn’t have access to the systems people use to do their jobs.
sentences.zh: 这是有道理的：如果人工智能无法访问人们用来完成工作的系统，那么它在工作中就没有多大用处。

blocks.html_en: But handing over API keys to people and agents is dangerous and does not scale. Keys often provide broad, long-lived access that is difficult to constrain, share safely, and audit.

sentences.en: But handing over API keys to people and agents is dangerous and does not scale.
sentences.zh: 但将 API 密钥移交给人员和代理是危险的，而且无法扩展。

sentences.en: Keys often provide broad, long-lived access that is difficult to constrain, share safely, and audit.
sentences.zh: 密钥通常提供广泛、长期的访问，但难以限制、安全共享和审核。

blocks.html_en: MCP gives agents a better way to use these systems. An MCP server can hold the credential and expose a defined set of tools instead of handing the key directly to the agent. But controlling which tools an agent can call is only the first step. MCP alone does not tell us which underlying resources an agent has observed. The agent can combine information across systems, send it somewhere less restricted, or expose it through apps and outputs to people who may not be allowed to see the original resources. Authorization has to account for where the data can go next.

sentences.en: MCP gives agents a better way to use these systems.
sentences.zh: MCP 为代理商提供了更好的方式来使用这些系统。

sentences.en: An MCP server can hold the credential and expose a defined set of tools instead of handing the key directly to the agent.
sentences.zh: MCP 服务器可以保存凭证并公开一组定义的工具，而不是将密钥直接交给代理。

sentences.en: But controlling which tools an agent can call is only the first step.
sentences.zh: 但控制代理可以调用​​哪些工具只是第一步。

sentences.en: MCP alone does not tell us which underlying resources an agent has observed.
sentences.zh: 仅 MCP 并不能告诉我们代理观察到了哪些底层资源。

sentences.en: The agent can combine information across systems, send it somewhere less restricted, or expose it through apps and outputs to people who may not be allowed to see the original resources.
sentences.zh: 代理可以跨系统组合信息，将其发送到限制较少的地方，或者通过应用程序和输出将其公开给可能不允许查看原始资源的人。

sentences.en: Authorization has to account for where the data can go next.
sentences.zh: 授权必须考虑数据下一步的去向。

blocks.html_en: Agents start with no access

sentences.en: Agents start with no access
sentences.zh: 代理一开始就没有访问权限

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare Access controls who can enter Cloudflare OS. Inside, every agent and app starts with access to nothing. An agent can ask for access to a specific resource, which you can grant or deny. Generated code receives that resource as a typed binding:

sentences.en: Cloudflare Access controls who can enter Cloudflare OS.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare Access 控制谁可以进入 Cloudflare OS。

sentences.en: Inside, every agent and app starts with access to nothing.
sentences.zh: 在内部，每个代理和应用程序一开始都无法访问任何内容。

sentences.en: An agent can ask for access to a specific resource, which you can grant or deny.
sentences.zh: 代理可以请求访问特定资源，您可以授予或拒绝该访问权限。

sentences.en: Generated code receives that resource as a typed binding:
sentences.zh: 生成的代码接收该资源作为类型化绑定：

blocks.html_en: env.PROJECT is a capability representing permission to use a specific resource under a specific policy. The credential remains completely isolated from the agent and any generated code.

sentences.en: env.PROJECT is a capability representing permission to use a specific resource under a specific policy.
sentences.zh: env.PROJECT 是一种能力，表示在特定策略下使用特定资源的权限。

sentences.en: The credential remains completely isolated from the agent and any generated code.
sentences.zh: 凭证与代理和任何生成的代码完全隔离。

blocks.html_en: Server code runs in a Dynamic Worker with global outbound networking disabled. Client code runs in a sandboxed frame in the browser. Neither can reach the Internet except through capabilities you explicitly provide.

sentences.en: Server code runs in a Dynamic Worker with global outbound networking disabled.
sentences.zh: 服务器代码在禁用全局出站网络的动态工作线程中运行。

sentences.en: Client code runs in a sandboxed frame in the browser.
sentences.zh: 客户端代码在浏览器的沙盒框架中运行。

sentences.en: Neither can reach the Internet except through capabilities you explicitly provide.
sentences.zh: 除非通过您明确提供的功能，否则两者都无法访问互联网。

blocks.html_en: Gatekeepers govern resources and actions

sentences.en: Gatekeepers govern resources and actions
sentences.zh: 看门人管理资源和行动

blocks.html_en: A Gatekeeper is a service-specific Worker that sits between Cloudflare OS and an external service. It understands the service’s API, its resources, and the operations that can be performed on them.

sentences.en: A Gatekeeper is a service-specific Worker that sits between Cloudflare OS and an external service.
sentences.zh: Gatekeeper 是位于 Cloudflare OS 和外部服务之间的特定于服务的 Worker。

sentences.en: It understands the service’s API, its resources, and the operations that can be performed on them.
sentences.zh: 它了解服务的 API、其资源以及可以对其执行的操作。

blocks.html_en: Giving an agent access to your entire GitHub account is likely too broad. A Gatekeeper can give it access to a single repository, allow it to read issues but not source code, mask particular fields, apply rate limits, and require approval before merging a pull request.

sentences.en: Giving an agent access to your entire GitHub account is likely too broad.
sentences.zh: 授予代理访问您整个 GitHub 帐户的权限可能过于宽泛。

sentences.en: A Gatekeeper can give it access to a single repository, allow it to read issues but not source code, mask particular fields, apply rate limits, and require approval before merging a pull request.
sentences.zh: Gatekeeper 可以授予其对单个存储库的访问权限、允许其读取问题但不能读取源代码、屏蔽特定字段、应用速率限制以及在合并拉取请求之前需要批准。

blocks.html_en: The agent and its apps see a small TypeScript API. The Gatekeeper handles OAuth, holds the credential, enforces policy, records what was read, and mediates anything with an externally visible side effect.

sentences.en: The agent and its apps see a small TypeScript API.
sentences.zh: 代理及其应用程序会看到一个小型 TypeScript API。

sentences.en: The Gatekeeper handles OAuth, holds the credential, enforces policy, records what was read, and mediates anything with an externally visible side effect.
sentences.zh: Gatekeeper 处理 OAuth、保存凭证、执行策略、记录读取的内容以及调解任何具有外部可见副作用的内容。

blocks.html_en: Policy follows what the agent has seen

sentences.en: Policy follows what the agent has seen
sentences.zh: 政策遵循代理人所见

blocks.html_en: Controlling the initial read is not enough. Take, for example, the case where an agent reads a sensitive table in a data warehouse and uses it to produce a live dashboard. Sharing the dashboard must not become a way to share the table with people who could not access it directly.

sentences.en: Controlling the initial read is not enough.
sentences.zh: 控制初始读取是不够的。

sentences.en: Take, for example, the case where an agent reads a sensitive table in a data warehouse and uses it to produce a live dashboard.
sentences.zh: 以代理读取数据仓库中的敏感表并使用它来生成实时仪表板的情况为例。

sentences.en: Sharing the dashboard must not become a way to share the table with people who could not access it directly.
sentences.zh: 共享仪表板不得成为与无法直接访问该表的人员共享表的一种方式。

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare OS records every resource agents observe. These observations remain attached to the agent and its work. When another person tries to open the workspace, interact with the agent, or view what it produced, Gatekeepers verify that person's access to the observed resources.

sentences.en: Cloudflare OS records every resource agents observe.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare OS 记录了代理观察到的每个资源。

sentences.en: These observations remain attached to the agent and its work.
sentences.zh: 这些观察结果仍然与代理及其工作相关。

sentences.en: When another person tries to open the workspace, interact with the agent, or view what it produced, Gatekeepers verify that person's access to the observed resources.
sentences.zh: 当另一个人尝试打开工作区、与代理交互或查看其生成的内容时，Gatekeepers 会验证该人对所观察资源的访问权限。

blocks.html_en: The same observation log is used to inform policies that determine when agents can make external requests. A read of sensitive data can prevent the agent from writing data to certain sources, inviting new collaborators, handing work to another agent, or making an outbound request.

sentences.en: The same observation log is used to inform policies that determine when agents can make external requests.
sentences.zh: 相同的观察日志用于通知确定代理何时可以发出外部请求的策略。

sentences.en: A read of sensitive data can prevent the agent from writing data to certain sources, inviting new collaborators, handing work to another agent, or making an outbound request.
sentences.zh: 读取敏感数据可能会阻止代理将数据写入某些源、邀请新协作者、将工作移交给另一个代理或发出出站请求。

blocks.html_en: People using agents or building apps do not have to worry about making these mistakes. The platform can now be used to handle this.

sentences.en: People using agents or building apps do not have to worry about making these mistakes.
sentences.zh: 使用代理或构建应用程序的人不必担心犯这些错误。

sentences.en: The platform can now be used to handle this.
sentences.zh: 现在可以使用该平台来处理此问题。

blocks.html_en: A platform for building and sharing personal, modifiable apps

sentences.en: A platform for building and sharing personal, modifiable apps
sentences.zh: 用于构建和共享个人可修改应用程序的平台

blocks.html_en: Most productivity suites give you a fixed set of applications: documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. In Cloudflare OS, each “file” can be its own application, written by an agent for one person, one project, or one team.

sentences.en: Most productivity suites give you a fixed set of applications: documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.
sentences.zh: 大多数生产力套件为您提供一组固定的应用程序：文档、电子表格和演示文稿。

sentences.en: In Cloudflare OS, each “file” can be its own application, written by an agent for one person, one project, or one team.
sentences.zh: 在 Cloudflare OS 中，每个“文件”都可以是自己的应用程序，由代理为一个人、一个项目或一个团队编写。

blocks.html_en: These are not prototypes that you have to export and deploy somewhere else. Each one is a full-stack application with client code, server code, an API, and durable state. Apps are private by default, but can be shared like documents.

sentences.en: These are not prototypes that you have to export and deploy somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 这些不是您必须导出并部署到其他地方的原型。

sentences.en: Each one is a full-stack application with client code, server code, an API, and durable state.
sentences.zh: 每一个都是一个全栈应用程序，包含客户端代码、服务器代码、API 和持久状态。

content_html_zh:
每个组织都有一个使命，一个存在的理由。 组织将这一使命及其术语、程序、系统、标准和工作方式传递给员工。 反过来，人们将这一背景与他们自己的经验结合起来，并为实现使命而努力。

工作可以采取多种形式，从代码到文档和幻灯片，到关系，到物理世界中的结果。

其中一些很简单：代码要么运行，要么不运行。 在过去的几年里，代理一直在使用这种反馈循环来生成对开发人员“有效”的代码。 但我们其他人呢？

为组织的其他部门带来同样的影响力是一个更难的问题。 座席需要了解公司的背景，并能够访问人们用来完成工作的系统。 他们需要将这种背景和访问权限转化为推动组织实现其使命的工作。

这就是我们创建 Cloudflare OS 的原因。 它为每个人提供了一个围绕其公司构建的代理和工作空间：它如何工作、它知道什么以及它所依赖的系统。

今年 5 月，我们为 Cloudflare 的每个人提供了 Cloudflare OS 第一个版本的访问权限。 每个职能部门都有成千上万的人（其中许多人不是工程人员）每天使用它来创建文档和幻灯片、自动执行可重复的任务以及构建小型应用程序来可视化数据并帮助他们完成工作。

Cloudflare OS 还为每个人提供了由 Cloudflare 团队构建的共享上下文和技能库。 它捕获了我们执行重复性工作的术语、程序和最著名的方法，作为代理可以遵循的说明。 当一个人找到一种更好的方法来做某事时，其他人都可以使用它。

今天，我们开源了新版本的 Cloudflare OS。 任何组织都可以部署它，将其连接到内部系统，并使其成为自己的系统。

我们从第一个版本中学到了什么

我们今天开源的 Cloudflare 操作系统基于我们从内部运行第一个版本中学到的知识，我们的首席信息官 Sam Rhea 在他的博客文章中介绍了这一历程。

第一个版本以个人通过私人工作空间与代理合作为中心。 应用程序是静态的，而不是连接到内部系统的实时软件，并且大多数确定性作业仍然需要再次运行代理技能并消耗更多的模型令牌。

合作暴露了一个更根本的挑战。 对 MCP 服务器的访问告诉我们代理可以调用​​哪些工具，但没有告诉我们代理观察到了哪些底层资源。 一旦人们开始共享工作空间、应用程序和输出，我们就需要确保协作不会泄露他人不被允许看到的信息。

我们在新的基础上重建了 Cloudflare OS 来解决这些问题。 安全性必须成为平台的一部分，而不是每个构建应用程序或使用代理的人都必须正确实现。

结果是一个设计为属于运行它的公司的平台。 您可以自定义界面、连接工具并添加捕捉组织运作方式的技能和上下文。

Cloudflare 操作系统简介

与许多其他 AI 工具一样，Cloudflare OS 从浏览器中的对话开始。 其与众不同之处在于，每次对话都基于您的组织策划的背景和技能。 为您的工作空间设定一个目标，它可以利用该知识并使用您的组织已使用的工具和数据来实现该目标。

Cloudflare OS 结合了三个部分：

  • 座席工作区基于您公司策划的上下文和技能，具有隔离的运行时，座席可以在其中编写和运行代码。
  • 用于安全访问内部数据和服务的新安全和治理框架。
  • 一个个人、可修改应用程序的平台，人们可以构建、共享和继续更改。

最初的对话可以成为文档、应用程序或继续工作的工作流程。

适合公司每个人的座席工作空间

代理工作区专为组织中的每个人而设计。 您可以在浏览器中与它们交互，因此您不必是开发人员或知道如何使用终端。

工作区结合了代理会话、持久状态、输出和文件、资源访问以及代理可以在其中编写和运行代码的隔离运行时。

它们充满了您的团队或公司收集的精选背景和技能。 不再需要为每项任务重新发明轮子——如果团队中有人找到了做某事的最佳方法，那么每个人都会受益。 人们不再需要在每次开始任务时向模型解释相同的流程、术语和最佳实践。

您可以做一些事情：

研究并提出问题

要求工作空间使用公司背景和您提供的资源来研究某个主题。 代理可以编写代码来搜索、过滤、连接和分析信息，而不是将整个数据集拉入模型的上下文窗口。

创建文档、幻灯片和电子表格

工作区可以将其研究转化为您可以继续编辑的文档、演示文稿或电子表格。 这些输出不必是静态文件。 它们可以保持与实时数据的连接，随着来源的变化而更新，并且仍然可以导出为熟悉的格式或服务，例如 Google Drive。

为您的团队创建协作、互联的应用程序

当文档或电子表格不够时，代理可以构建具有自己的界面、逻辑和状态的应用程序。 该应用程序可以使用连接的公司资源并支持多人协同工作。

运行确定性工作流程

并非每项工作都需要完整的代理会话。 许多都是已知的步骤序列，其中有一两个地方的判断是有用的。 工作区可以将这些作业转变为大部分确定性的工作流程，使用可预测步骤的代码和仅在增加价值的地方使用模型。 工作流程可以按需、按计划运行，或者在连接的系统中发生事件时运行。

Cloudflare OS 允许代理和应用程序通过 Gatekeepers 管理对记录系统的访问（更多信息请参见下面的安全部分）。 它还支持您的组织已通过 MCP 服务器门户使用的现有模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器。

用于安全访问内部数据和服务的新安全和治理框架

当人们开始在工作中尝试人工智能时，他们的第一个请求通常是获取公司系统的 API 密钥。 这是有道理的：如果人工智能无法访问人们用来完成工作的系统，那么它在工作中就没有多大用处。

但将 API 密钥移交给人员和代理是危险的，而且无法扩展。 密钥通常提供广泛、长期的访问，但难以限制、安全共享和审核。

MCP 为代理商提供了更好的方式来使用这些系统。 MCP 服务器可以保存凭证并公开一组定义的工具，而不是将密钥直接交给代理。 但控制代理可以调用​​哪些工具只是第一步。 仅 MCP 并不能告诉我们代理观察到了哪些底层资源。 代理可以跨系统组合信息，将其发送到限制较少的地方，或者通过应用程序和输出将其公开给可能不允许查看原始资源的人。 授权必须考虑数据下一步的去向。

代理一开始就没有访问权限

Cloudflare Access 控制谁可以进入 Cloudflare OS。 在内部，每个代理和应用程序一开始都无法访问任何内容。 代理可以请求访问特定资源，您可以授予或拒绝该访问权限。 生成的代码接收该资源作为类型化绑定：

const issues = await env.PROJECT.listIssues({
  teamId: "ENG",
  state: "open",
});

env.PROJECT 是一种能力，表示在特定策略下使用特定资源的权限。 凭证与代理和任何生成的代码完全隔离。

服务器代码在禁用全局出站网络的动态工作线程中运行。 客户端代码在浏览器的沙盒框架中运行。 除非通过您明确提供的功能，否则两者都无法访问互联网。

看门人管理资源和行动

Gatekeeper 是位于 Cloudflare OS 和外部服务之间的特定于服务的 Worker。 它了解服务的 API、其资源以及可以对其执行的操作。

授予代理访问您整个 GitHub 帐户的权限可能过于宽泛。 Gatekeeper 可以授予其对单个存储库的访问权限、允许其读取问题但不能读取源代码、屏蔽特定字段、应用速率限制以及在合并拉取请求之前需要批准。

代理及其应用程序会看到一个小型 TypeScript API。 Gatekeeper 处理 OAuth、保存凭证、执行策略、记录读取的内容以及调解任何具有外部可见副作用的内容。

政策遵循代理人所见

控制初始读取是不够的。 以代理读取数据仓库中的敏感表并使用它来生成实时仪表板的情况为例。 共享仪表板不得成为与无法直接访问该表的人员共享表的一种方式。

Cloudflare OS 记录了代理观察到的每个资源。 这些观察结果仍然与代理及其工作相关。 当另一个人尝试打开工作区、与代理交互或查看其生成的内容时，Gatekeepers 会验证该人对所观察资源的访问权限。

相同的观察日志用于通知确定代理何时可以发出外部请求的策略。 读取敏感数据可能会阻止代理将数据写入某些源、邀请新协作者、将工作移交给另一个代理或发出出站请求。

使用代理或构建应用程序的人不必担心犯这些错误。 现在可以使用该平台来处理此问题。

用于构建和共享个人可修改应用程序的平台

大多数生产力套件为您提供一组固定的应用程序：文档、电子表格和演示文稿。 在 Cloudflare OS 中，每个“文件”都可以是自己的应用程序，由代理为一个人、一个项目或一个团队编写。

这些不是您必须导出并部署到其他地方的原型。 每一个都是一个全栈应用程序，包含客户端代码、服务器代码、API 和持久状态。 应用程序默认是私有的，但可以像文档一样共享。

每个应用程序都是一个 Worker

当您要求工作区构建应用程序时，代理会编写两部分：

  • 在浏览器中呈现应用程序 UI 的客户端代码
  • 存储状态并实现应用程序行为的服务器代码

服务器按需加载为 Dynamic Worker 并实例化为 Durable Object Facet（两者都是我们为此项目构建的功能）。 该方面为应用程序提供了自己的 SQLite 数据库，与管理它的 Cloudflare OS 运行时分开。 Dynamic Workers 使用轻量级 V8 隔离，因此每个应用程序都可以拥有自己的隔离运行时，而不需要专用服务器或容器。

浏览器客户端使用 Cloudflare 的开源对象功能远程过程调用 (RPC) 系统 Cap’n Web 与服务器进行通信。 服务器方法可以像普通 JavaScript 函数一样从客户端调用：

const issues = await app.listIssues({
 status: "done",
});

特殊之处在于代理也可以调用相同的方法。

因此，如果您可以自己构建一个工具来完成工作，那么代理可以在您不在场时使用您的工具来完成工作。

分享应用程序，或分享它的构建方式

当您在 Cloudflare OS 中构建应用程序时，您可以通过两种方式共享它们：

  • 共享您的应用程序本身可以让其他人使用相同的状态进行实时协作。
  • 共享应用程序的蓝图可以让其他人创建他们自己的应用程序副本。

从蓝图实例化的应用程序包含原始应用程序的代码。 但它不包含 SQLite 数据、对话历史记录、凭据或连接的资源。 每个新应用程序都以独立的状态和资源开始。

这意味着当您与团队共享应用程序时，他们可以使用人工智能自行修改它们，而不是提交功能请求并分配给您。

使用任何模型，并控制其成本

Cloudflare OS 可与任何型号一起使用。 每个推理调用都通过 Cloudflare AI Gateway 运行，让您的组织可以决定哪些模型可用以及哪个模型应处理每项作业。

并非每项任务都需要最昂贵的模型。 您可能不想每天早上运行最昂贵的前沿模型来总结未读的电子邮件。 AI Gateway 为您提供所需的控制，以确保昂贵的模型仅用于最艰苦的工作。

每个请求都归因于提出该请求的个人、团队或工作空间。 管理员可以查看推理支出的去向，设置预算和速率限制，并决定达到限制时会发生什么。
